# Example Docs

> A neutral example site for jekyll-theme-modootoday. Every page has a Markdown twin at `<page>/index.md`.

## Docs

- [Home](index.md): what the theme does and how to install it
- [Guide](guide/index.md): alerts, status badges, tables and code
